description: This source file defines a static class 'LegacyObservedApiEndpoints' that registers legacy/compatibility endpoints for a web API. It contains methods that map endpoints for managing site assets, EF source mappings, and throughput equations, delegating calls to underlying business logic layers. The file also defines request contract classes for managing site assets and removing site assets, providing backward-compatible request shapes for legacy clients.

classes.name: ManageSiteAssetsRequest
classes.description: A request contract class for managing site assets, supporting create and update operations with validation logic.

classes.name: RemoveSiteAssetRequest
classes.description: A request class for removing (soft deleting) a site asset, including audit and trace fields.

methods.name: MapLegacyObservedApiEndpoints
methods.description: Entry point to register all legacy endpoints under the '/api' route group.

methods.name: MapSiteAssetsObservedEndpoints
methods.description: Maps endpoints for managing site assets, including create/update and remove operations.

methods.name: MapInputEfSourceMappingObservedEndpoints
methods.description: Maps endpoints for EF source mapping CRUD operations attached to assets.

methods.name: MapCalculatedThroughputEquationSetupObservedEndpoints
methods.description: Maps an endpoint for generating throughput equations for input parameters.
